mentions.name: Canada-focused contract analysis tool
mentions.description: A tool that analyzes contracts and EULAs, with an initial geographic focus on Canada, intended to help handle the volume of contract and EULA updates arriving by email.
mentions.problem: The builder receives a lot of contract and EULA updates in their inbox and needs a way to analyze them.
mentions.source_excerpt: planning on building a tool to analyze contracts.  Currently focused on Canada.
mentions.author: edimaudo
